description.value: Panago is a Canadian pizza chain franchise with a location in Coquitlam's Clarke Road corridor, known for using 100% Canadian wheat dough made fresh in-house and organic tomato sauce. The menu leans into plant-based and meat-free options alongside conventional pizzas, salads, and sides. A touring cyclist passing through Coquitlam could stop here for a quick hot meal or a takeout order.
